D: A diner waitress stuck in a bad marriage pours everything into the pies she invents.
P: Serve the pies when Jenna starts dreaming up a new one.
S: Mini quiche tarts with brie, ham and chives

Shortcrust blind baked in a mini muffin tin, filled with brie, smoked ham and a custard of eggs and cream, baked at 170C for 15 minutes until just set. Line a 24-hole mini muffin tin with rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust and blind-bake. Fill with 100g diced brie and 80g chopped ham. Whisk 2 eggs with 150ml cream and chives, pour in and bake at 170C for 15 minutes.
Buttermilk biscuits under creamy sausage gravy
Buttermilk biscuits baked at 220C for 12 minutes, split and covered in a peppery sausage gravy of browned sausage mince, flour and milk.
Old Joe's cinnamon pie crust twists
the cranky old owner who loves her pies

Buttery shortcrust brushed with melted butter, showered in cinnamon sugar, cut into strips and twisted, baked crisp and caramelised, with warm caramel for dipping. Brush 2 sheets shortcrust pastry with 40g melted butter. Mix 60g sugar with 2 tsp cinnamon and sprinkle over both. Cut into 2cm strips, twist each a few times and lay on lined trays. Bake at 190C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp and caramelised. Warm 4 tbsp thick caramel with 1 tbsp cream for dipping.
M: Chicken thigh, carrot, celery and peas in a creamy sauce under puff pastry
Chicken thighs, carrot, celery, onion and peas in a thick creamy sauce with thyme, under a puff pastry lid, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes.
Pie diner meatloaf with brown gravy
the lunch rush at the diner

Beef and pork meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, sliced thick over buttery mash with onion brown gravy and green beans. Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk and mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, a grated onion, 1 egg and salt. Press into a loaf tin, spread with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 2 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter. Soften a sliced onion, stir in 1 tbsp flour and 400ml beef stock and simmer for gravy. Steam 300g green beans.
W: Cookie crust, caramel and dark chocolate ganache, finished with flaky salt

Biscuit crust, a layer of salted caramel, then a bittersweet chocolate ganache set over it, drowned in more caramel and a little flaky salt. Press 200g crushed biscuits with 80g melted butter into a pie tin. Melt 250g caramels with 3 tbsp cream and pour in. Pour over 200g dark chocolate melted with 150ml cream and set. Drizzle more caramel and flaky salt on top.
K: Chilled coffee blended with vanilla ice cream and salted caramel, whipped cream

Cold brewed coffee blended thick with vanilla ice cream and salted caramel, poured into tall glasses with whipped cream and a crumble of pie crust. Brew 400ml strong coffee and chill. Blend with 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 200ml cold milk and 4 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of salt until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses, top with whipped cream, a drizzle of caramel and a few crumbled shortbread biscuits.

prop.title: Pie of the Day
lines: I Don't Want Earl's Baby Pie

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Cut rounds from the pastry, line a 24 hole mini muffin tin and blind-bake.
Dice the brie and ham and chop the chives.
Fill the cases. Whisk the eggs with the cream, pour in and bake at 170C.
Bake until just set.
Rub the butter into part of the flour with the baking powder and stir in the buttermilk.
Cut rounds and bake at 220C.
Brown the sausage mince, stir in the remaining flour and then the milk.
Simmer with lots of pepper until thick.
Split the biscuits and pour over the gravy.
Brown the chicken, then add the diced onion, carrots, celery and thyme.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick.
Add the peas and tip into a pie dish.
Cover with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C.
Crush the biscuits, mix with melted butter and press into a pie tin.
Melt the caramels with some of the cream and pour in.
Heat the rest of the cream, pour over the chocolate and stir to a ganache. Pour over the caramel.
Chill until set.
Drizzle with more caramel and scatter flaky salt on top.

dishes.make_ahead: Coffee chilled up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brew the coffee and chill.
Whip the cream.
Blend the coffee, ice cream, milk and caramel with a pinch of salt until smooth.
Pour into tall glasses, top with whipped cream, a drizzle of caramel and crumbled shortbread.

s.note: Buttermilk biscuits under creamy sausage gravy
s.how: Rub 100g butter into 300g flour with 3 tsp baking powder and stir in 250ml buttermilk. Cut rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brown 300g sausage mince, stir in 2 tbsp flour and 400ml milk and simmer with lots of pepper. Pour over the split biscuits.

m.note: Chicken thigh, carrot, celery and peas in a creamy sauce under puff pastry
m.how: Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, add a diced onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks with thyme. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, 250ml stock and 200ml cream and simmer until thick, then add 150g peas. Cover with puff pastry, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
